notes:
Add displays: 7-segment, LED bar, 8x8 dot matrix, text LCD

The coming chapter on buses and displays needs them. Segments and LEDs
light from their own inputs; the matrix lights where a row is 1 and a
column 0 and lets LEDs glow on a moment, so scanning rows (multiplexing)
shows a whole picture; the LCD writes the character code D7..D0 on a
rising edge at WR and clears on CLR. All in a new palette group
"Displays" with the hex display, lexicon texts and pin descriptions.
